d:
Bihar ke baksar ke ramrekha ghat se ek khas dharmik khabar samne aaee hai. bhagvan shriram se juri pavitr nagri baksar ke ramrekha ghat ka gangajal ab aurangabad ke kaee talabon, pokhron aur nadiyon men pahunchaya jaega, jahan chhath mahaparv ke dauran chhathavrati bhagvan sury ko arghy denge.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
